critical_code_review_comments: Test note: raw '../../' in URL path gets normalized by HTTP client/proxy stack BEFORE reaching the route handler (resolved to /api/admin/nidp/archive/etc/passwd, returning 307). The actual server-side traversal guard only triggers on URL-encoded payloads (..%2F..%2F). Functionally fine because no real attacker payload would survive normalization either, but the server-side validator is only hit when a client refuses to normalize — the layered defense IS working (encoded payload returns 400 with 'invalid path' as expected). No code change needed.

Observation: 8 derived/event services (announcement_classifier, d1_prep, document_parser, event_calendar, event_day_poller, intelligence, price_adjuster, quality_gate) still show 'never' last_run since they don't write to nidp.job_log. Confirmed expected per main agent's note — not flagged as regression.
